tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// !" brgya bzhi'i cho ga slob dpon padmas mdzad pa bzhugs so// e waṃ:

rgya gar skad du/ tshal pa'i ghor to/ bod skad du/ brgya bzhi'i cho ga /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// mo ngan pa dang*/ rtags ngan pa dang*/ skeg che ba dang*/ phyogs ngan du phyin pa dang*/ gzhan gyi gyur phogs pa dang*/ yul na 'go ba'i nad yod pa dang*/ ban bon gyi phur kha gnod pa dang*/ rang gi rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ yul mi khyim mdzes kyi byur 'dre pha spun pha mtshan gyi byur 'dre dang*/ bon zor chos zor dang*/ phyugs la rgod kha 'byung ba dang*/ khyim du rgyal po bzhugs pa dang*/ gtad du tshud pa dang*/ dgra rkun sdang ba dang*/ skyes pa la dgra dar ba dang*/ shi 'phro ma chad pa dang*/ gza' skar ngan pa bzlog pa dang*/ ma nyes ko long byung ba dang*/ bla 'khyams tshe 'khyams byung ba dang*/ dgu mig dur mig tu tshud pa dang*/ de ltar ngan pa thams cad 'dis bzlog pa'i thabs la brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'di bya'o// las gzhung la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ las gzhung bsrang ba dngos so// dang po la gsum te/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ rdzas 'god pa'o// de la dang po skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed legs par byas la/ de nas bde bar gshegs pa rnams la phyag rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ni/ logs re la khru re bya/ dbus zlum por bya'o// de'i phyi rims padma 'dab brgyad/ gru chad ljang khu/ bar khyams ser/ lha rnams rang gi kha dog dang bstun/ sgo phyogs mtshon bri/ gzhan rnams phyogs spyi dang mthun pa'o// de nas rdzas 'god pa ni gnyis te/ byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ 'god pa'o// dang po bdag nyid kha shar du bltas la/ cho ga gsum gyi lhar bskyed la/ bum pa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ bla ma'i zhal las so// gtor ma ni a ros byin gyis brlabs so// mchod pa lnga ni spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs pa'o// blud ni phung po khams dang skye mched dang ldan pas/ 'gro ba mi phyugs kyi blud du bsngo zhing byin gyis brlabs so// tsha tsha ni bde bar gshegs pa'i sku ru byin gyis brlabs te/

'gro ba'i sdug bsngal skyob cing thugs rjes 'dzin par brlabs po// chab gtor ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ste/ tshe dang longs spyod rgyas/ 'gal skyen thams cad ni dbang du bsdus/ las thams cad mthar phyin par byin gyis brlabs so// mdo 'don pa ni ya skan la/ chos kyi rnga'o cher byin gyis brlabs/ lce hūṃ las rdo rje bsam/ de nas mdo 'don pas/ lce rdo rje ya skan rnga bo che brdungs pas/ stong gsum thams cad chos kyi rnga bo che'i sgra chen pos khyab ste/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud grol te/ sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlabs so// mda' bzhi ni/ skyes pa'i srog brten/ me long bzhi ni bud med kyi srog brten/ dar sna bzhi ni byis pa'i srog brten du byin gyis brlabs ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhi la btsugs so// de nas zhal zas tshogs kyi pū tsa ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lngar bsam ste/ yar mgron gyi mchod pa dang*/ mar gyi mgron la byin par bya'o// gnyis pa rdzas 'god pa ni/ gnyis la dang por rigs lngas 'god pa ni/ spyan drangs pa ni/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// gti mug rnam par dag pa'i sku// chos dbyings ye shes thob bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs su gsol// buddha lo tsa ni a bhi ṣañtsa sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i sku// me long ye shes thob bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor shar du bzhugs su gsol// badzra a sho bhya sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i sku// mnyam nyid ye shes thob bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor lho ru bzhugs su gsol// ratna a wa bha tri sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i sku// kun rtog ye shes thob bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor nub tu bzhugs su gsol// padma a ti sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/

hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// phra dog rnam par dag pa'i sku// nan tan ye shes thob bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor byang du bzhugs su gsol// karma a ma ka sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// mtshan ma rnam par dag pa'i sku// mtshan ma dbyings su sgrol bya'i phyir// kun tu bzang mo bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// dkar mo chen mo dbu dgu ma// tshe dang g.yang mchog sgrub bya'i phyir// dkar mo chen mo bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// mtsho sman rgyal mo mched dgu yang*// sa bdag klu gnyan gdul bya'i phyir// mtsho sman rgyal mo bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// nag mo chen mo rims bdag mo// nad rims dal kha bcad pa'i phyir// nag mo chen mo bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ chos dbyings spros pa med pa las// dmug mo chen mo dbu lnga ma// sri 'u bso zhing skyong ba'i phyir// smug mo chen mo bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po'i shar phyogs na// rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung*// dri za rnams la dbang gyur phyir// shar gyi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po'i lho phyogs na// rgyal po chen mo 'phags skyes po// gshin rje rnams la dbang gyur phyir// lho'i phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po'i nub phyogs na// rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang*// klu dbang rnams la dbang gyur phyir// nub kyi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ ri rgyal lhun po byang phyogs na// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin rnams la dbang gyur zhing*// byang gi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ shar gyi dkar mo las mkhan ma// rdo rje rigs kyi gtso mo ste// zhi ba'i las rnams grub byed ma// shar gyi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/

lho'i ser mo las mkhan ma// rin chen rigs kyi gtso mo ste// rgyas pa'i las rnams grub byed ma// lho'i phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ nub kyi dmar mo las mkhan ma// padma rigs kyi gtso mo ste// dbang gi las rnams grub byed ma// nub kyi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ byang gi sngon mo las mkhan ma// las kyi rigs kyi gtso mo ste// drag po'i las rnams grub byed ma// byang gi phyogs su bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ shar gyi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog dkar mo lcags kyu rnams// shar gyi sgo mar bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ lho'i sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog ser mo zhags pa bsnams// lho'i sgo mar bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ nub kyi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog dmar mo lcags sgrog bsnams// nub kyi sgo mar bzhugs su gsol// hūṃ/ byang gi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog ljang khu dril bu bsnams// byang gi sgo mar bzhugs su gsol// bum pa 'god pa ni/ hūṃ/ kun bzang yum gyi bum pa ni// khrus dang dbang bskur bya ba'i phyir// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid du// dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs su gsol// dzñā na bhi dha bhruṃ a bhi ṣeñtsa hūṃ/ sa ma yā tiṣṭha lhan/ zhes bum pa 'god do// gtor ma'i bzhugs gsol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ gtor gzhong rnam dag chos kyi dbyings// gtor ma bdud rtsi chen po la// lha dang lha min mchod bya'i phyir// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'di// dkyil 'khor chen po'i brgyan du bkram// mahā bha ling ta sa ma yā tiṣṭha lhan/ /blud kyi bzhugs gsol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ gser dngul zangs lcags rin chen rnam pa lnga// rnam shes phung po lnga ldan pa'i// lus ngag yid gsum bslu ba'i phyir// ji ltar 'tshams par gnas 'gyur cig /sa ma yā tiṣṭha lhan/ tsha tsha'i bzhugs gsol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ rin chen lnga dang 'byung ba lnga// sa mtshon lnga las grub pa yis// bde gshegs sku rten tsha tsha 'di// 'jigs pa skyob phyir bzhugs su gsol// ka ni ka sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/

/mdo 'bran gyi bzhugs gsol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// theg pa mchog la 'jug pa'i phyir// chos kyi phung po mdo sde 'di// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// dharma sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ /chu gtor gyi bzhugs su gsol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ chu yi 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i tshe// dgos pa thams cad tshang bar stan// me'i 'jigs pa bsrung ba'i phyir// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// pa ni bha ling ta sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ mar me bzhugs gsol bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ ma rig mun pa gsal ba'i phyir// ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me 'di// bdag dang gzhan don 'grub bya'i phyir// ye shes gsal ba'i rten du bzhugs su gsol// dzñā na dzwa la raṃ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ mda' dar bzhugs gsol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ mda' bzhi dar sna me long bzhi// 'dod yon longs spyod thob bya'i phyir// dkyil 'khor chen po'i brgyan du bkram// 'dod yon lnga'i bzhugs gsol bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs// 'dod yon lnga yi pū tsa 'di// mchod sbyin longs spyod thob bya'i phyir// 'phangs pa med pa'i sems kyis bkram// a la la ste bzhugs su gsol// zhes tshogs gcig 'byor sreg go /de dag la ni bkod pa brgyan gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o// las gzhung dngos la lnga ste/ bskyed pa dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ spyan drangs pa mgron gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ pū tsa las kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ kha sgyur bzlog pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bkra shis dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ dang po la gnyis te/ dkon mchog spyir mchod pa dang*/ lha bskyed pa'o// dang po ni mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang*/ bstod pa yan chad 'bul lo// lha bskyed pa la gnyis te/ dang po rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ rang yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i thugs ngang las bhruṃ zhes brjod pas/ bdag gi thugs kha nas bhruṃ kha dog sna tshogs pa gcig 'phros pas/

'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pas bhruṃ bhi shwa bi shuddhe ratna maṇḍal bhruṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ bhruṃ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang*/ rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyi'i dbyibs mchod rten lta bu la/ nang padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gru chad bzhi dang bcas pa/ gdan nyi zla dang bcas pa bskyed do// gnyis pa lha bskyed pa la bzhi ste/ rigs lnga yab yum bskyed pa dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi dang*/ las mkhan bzhi dang*/ sgo ma bzhi bskyed pa'o// oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ lam ma ma ma ma/ las rigs lnga yab yum dang*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ bzhi las rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ bā bā bā bā/ bzhi las sring mo bzhi dang*/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ bzhi las sgo ma chen mo bzhi dang*/ de rnams ni gzhal yas khang gi nang du chad nas/ 'phro 'du gong ltar bya'o// lha so so'i phyag mtshan du gyur ste/ de rnams 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ chu la nya ltar gyi tshul du lha tshogs rnams bskyed do// de nas gnas gsum dang lnga ru yi ge bhruṃ gsum dang lnga ru byin gyis rlabs so// gnyis pa spyan drangs pa ni/ rdo rje dang dril bu lag tu thogs te/ na mo bsam gyis mi khyab phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na// lha dang lha min mkha' lding dri za mi'am ci// deng 'dir ston pas chos kyi char 'bebs kyis// gang dag nyan par 'dod pa 'dir gshegs la// de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni 'di skad do// hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i pho brang nas// bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum dang*// 'khor dang bcas te gnas 'di ru// bdag dang yon bdag don ched du// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// dkyil 'khor zur gyi padma la// rgyal chen rigs bzhi lcam dral bcas// bdag dang yon bdag don ched du// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi ru// bar chad bsrungs pa'i sgo ma bzhi// bdag dang yon bdag don ched du// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// e hya hi a na ya ho/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ zhes spyan drangs ste bskyed pa la bstim mo// de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ/ rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen mtha' yas 'grub// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// dkar sngo nag mo smug mo'i tshogs// kun bzang yum chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bzhi bdag la las mkhan sring*// dkar sngo dmar ljang bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par bsrungs// sgo ma chen mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das lha tshogs kyis// g.yog 'khor bran dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes yon bdag rnams la phyag rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bya'o// gsum pa mchod pa las kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ don gnyis pa las dang po spyir mchod pa rnam pa lnga 'bul ba ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yis// lha rdzas dam pa'i yon chab 'di// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga badzra a ha ra pū tsa me ga sa mud ṭa sa pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du gzhan yang bya'o// oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gandhe/ ne wi te/ shabda a hūṃ/ zhes gong bzhin sbyar ro// sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyis// mi dge sdig pa ci bgyis pa// rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas kyi// spyan sngar so sor bshags par bgyis// gnyis pa bye brag tu 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ dbus kyi rnam par snang mdzad ni// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar// phyag na 'khor lo zhags pa bsnams// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// shar gyi rdo rje sems dpa' ni// sku mdog mthing kha 'od zer 'bar// phyag na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// lho phyogs rin chen 'byung ldan ni// sku mdog ser la 'od zer 'bar// phyag na rin chen zhags pa bsnams// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// nub kyi snang ba mtha' yas ni// sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'bar// phyag na padma zhags pa bsnams// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// byang gi don yon grub pa ni// sku mdog ljang la 'od zer 'bar// phyag na rgya gram zhags pa bsnams// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// shar nas dkar mo dbu dgu ma// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// lho nas mtsho sman rgyal mo dgu// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// nub nas ma mo nag mo'i tshogs// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// byang nas smug mo dbu lnga ma// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// hūṃ/

shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// shar nas dkar mo spyan gcig ma// de la phyag 'tshal྾/ lho nas ma mo nag mo'i tshogs// de la phyag 'tshal྾/ nub nas dmar mo chu 'jib ma// de la phyag 'tshal྾/ byang nas ser mo las mkhan ma// de la phyag 'tshal྾/ shar nas byams pa lcags kyu ma// de la phyag 'tshal྾/ lho nas snying rje zhags pa ma// de la phyag 'tshal྾/ nub nas dga' ba lcags sgrog ma// de la phyag 'tshal྾/ byang nas btang snyoms dril bu ma// de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// phyi nang mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'phrin las grub par mdzod//

zhes arghaṃ zer phud zhal du sbreng ngo*// de nas bstod pa bya ba ni 'di skad do// hūṃ/ chos dbyings ye shes dam tshig ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku rnam snang mdzad// sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo bsnams// dngos grub stsol phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// me long ye shes dam tshig ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje sems// sku mdog mthing kha rdo rje bsnams// dngos grub stsol phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// mnyam nyid ye shes dam tshig ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku rin chen 'byung*// sku mdog ser po rin chen bsnams// dngos grub stsol phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// kun rtog ye shes dam tshig ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku snang mtha' yas// sku mdog dmar po padma bsnams// dngos grub stsol phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// nan tan ye shes dam tshig ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku don yon grub// sku mdog ljang khu rgya gram bsnams// dngos grub stsol phyir phyag 'tshal bstod// ging mo kun gyi gtso mo ste// tshe dang longs spyod spel ba'i phyir// dbu dgu ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo ste// nad kha rims kha bcad pa'i phyir// sngon mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// klu mo kun gyi gtso mo ste// sa bdag bdug pa 'dul bya'i phyir// nag mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// sman phran kun gyi gtso mo ste// sad dang ser ba bcad pa'i phyir// smug mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dri za kun gyi gtso mo ste// zhi ba'i 'phrin las grub byed pa// yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal bstod// grul bum kun gyi gtso mo ste// rgyas pa'i 'phrin las grub byed pa// 'phags skyes po la྾/ klu dbang kun gyi gtso bo ste// dbang gi las rnams grub byed pa// spyan mi bzang la྾/ gnod sbyin kun gyi gtso bo ste// drag po'i las rnams grub byed pa// rnam thos sras la྾/

gling bzhi 'gyogs ma lha'i sring*// shar gyi 'gyogs ma khyod la bstod// mkha' la khyung lding gshin rje'i sring*// lho'i 'gyogs ma khyod la྾/ dkar mo g.yag thong klu'i sring*// nub kyi 'gyogs ma khyod la྾/ nag mo gter chen gnod sbyin sring*// byang gi 'gyogs ma khyod la྾/ rtag par ma yin lcags kyu ma// 'gugs byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// chad par ma yin zhags pa ma// 'ching byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag tu ma yin lcags sgrog ma// sdom byed ma la྾/ mtshan mar ma yin dril bu ma// dgyes byed ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i// dngos grub stsol phyir las mdzad pa// gtso 'khor bran dang bcas rnams la// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod do// de nas zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa byas te/ dri chus sangs byang gi byin gyis brlabs la/ blud bsngo ba la bzhi ste/ cho ga'i sgo nas bsngo ba dang*/ brgya bzhi go nas bsngo ba'o// de la dang po cho ga'i go nas bsngo ba 'di skad do// 'dod pa yon tan gyi 'bul/ de nas kha sgyur bzlog pa la gnyis te/ cho ga'i bsngo ba dang rkyen bzlog pa'o// gser skyems 'bul zhing gtor la/ zhun mar rnams spar la 'di skad do// hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs la mar me gsum// sku'i mar me 'od zer 'phro// gsung gi mar me chags dang bral// thugs kyi mar me rgyan du che// sku gsung thugs kyi thugs dam bskangs// kun gzhi dbyings kyis ye shes la// dbyings nas rnam shes brgyad du gsal// byang chub sems kyi mar me 'di// khams gsum ma lus 'od du gsal// spyod pa yul gyi mar me 'di// bri gang med pa'i dbyings su 'bul// ye shes rgyan gyi mar me 'di// byang chub snying po'i rgyan du 'bul// gzugs kyi snying po'i mar me 'di// rang bzhin lhun grub dbyings su 'bul// shes rab brdal ba'i mar me 'di// dmigs med ye shes dbyings su྾/

sbyar ba'i dri yi mar me 'di// sems can kun la khyab par gsal// chags pa ro yi mar me 'di// srid zhu gus pa'i mdangs su྾/ chos nyid dbyings kyi mar me྾/ ma rig mun gsal dbyings su྾/ stan pa reg bya'i mar me྾/ mtshon pa med pa'i dbyings su྾/ kun gzhi dbyings kyi mar me྾/ rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings su྾/ nyon mongs yul gyi mar me྾/ bri skol med pa'i dbyings su྾/ thar par phyin pa'i mar me྾/ dngos grub las can dbyings su྾/ thugs nyid padma'i mar me྾/ gsal ba 'od 'phro'i dbyings su྾/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i mar me྾/ bag chags 'byongs phyir dbyings su྾/ rig pa bal gyi mar me྾/ dug gsum 'joms pa'i dbyings su 'bul// sku gsum mtshon pa'i mar me 'di// khams gsum yongs su gsal bar mdzod// mar me'i mchod pa 'di phul bas// thugs dam snyan po bskongs gyur cig /'khor bsrungs rkyen bzlog bar chad bsal// chags che bsgyur la nyams nga bzlog / 'di nas gzhung 'di nas 'dab/ hūṃ/ dbus kyi rnam par snang mdzad la// gzugs kyi phung po blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// de bzhin rigs su byin gyis rlobs// shar gyi rdo rje sems dpa' la// rnam shes phung po blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// rdo rje rigs su byin gyis rlobs// lho yi rin chen 'byung ldan la// tshor ba'i phung po blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// rin chen rigs su byin gyis rlobs// nub kyi snang ba mtha' yas la// 'du shes phung po blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// padma rigs su byin gyis྾/ byang gi don yod grub pa la// 'du byed phung po blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// las kyi rigs su byin gyis rlobs// hūṃ/ yum mchog kun tu bzang mo la// sems kyi blud du nam mkha' 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// chos nyid stong par byin྾/

yum mchog dkar mo dbu dgu ma// 'byung ba sa 'di blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// tshe srog sra zhing rgyas par mdzod// yum mchog mtsho sman rgyal mo la// 'byung ba chu 'di blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor la// yon tan ldan zhing rgyas par mdzod// yum mchog ma mo nag mo la// 'byung ba me 'di blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor kun// nyon mongs bag chags bsreg par byed// yum mchog smug ma dbu lnga ma// 'byung ba rlung 'di blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu྾/ rnam rtog sdul 'bud med par byed// hūṃ/ ri rgyal shar gyi rgyal chen la// lus 'phags gling gsum blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// ri rgyal lho'i rgyal chen la// 'dzam bu gling gsum blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ nad kyi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// ri rgyal nub kyi rgyal chen la// ba glang gling gsum blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ bsdul gyi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// ri rgyal byang gi rgyal chen la// sgra mi gling gsum blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ mu ge'i bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// hūṃ/ dkar mo las mkhan rdo rje'i rigs// 'gro ba'i sha rus blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ tshe srog sra zhing brtan par mdzod// ser mo las mkhan rin chen rigs// 'gro ba'i khrag dang chu ser blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ dbang thang dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// dmar mo las mkhan dbang gi rigs// 'gro ba'i drod chen blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ dgra 'gegs thams cad dbang du bsdus// byang nas las mkhan las kyis rigs// 'gro ba'i dbugs chen blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ 'phrin las thams cad 'grub par mdzod// hūṃ/ byams pa tshad med lcags kyu ma// 'gro ba'i lag g.yas blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/

dam nyams dgra bgegs khug las shog /snying rje tshad med bzhag pa la// 'gro ba'i lag g.yon blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ gnod pa'i dgra bgegs 'ching las shog /dga' ba tshad med lcags sgrog ma// 'gro ba'i rkang g.yas blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag྾/ bdud dang mu stegs sdom las shog /btang snyoms tshad med dril bu ma// 'gro ba'i rkang g.yon blud du 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag rgyu sbyor don ched du// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes par mdzod// bzhi pa brgya bzhi'i blud 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ tsha tsha brgya dang mdo tshar brgya// skyes pa pho'i blud du 'bul// chu gtor brgya dang ngar blud brgya// za ma mo'i blud du 'bul// cho ga brgya dang bzlas pa brgya// byis pa chung gi blud du 'bul// lus kyi blud du ngar blud 'bul// ngag gyi blud du mdo tshar 'bul// sems kyi blud du mar me྾/ phyugs kyi blud du chu gtor྾/ yon tan blud du tsha tsha྾/ mdangs kyi blud du dkyil 'khor྾/ dbang thang blud du dar zab྾/ longs spyod blud du tshogs gtor྾/ gzi mdangs blud du nam bza'྾/ yon bdag blud du brgya bzhi 'bul// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// mi mthun phyogs rnams gang tshe ba// srid pa'i brgya bzhis zhi bar mdzod// lha klu gnod sbyin lan chags la// brgya bzhis byin gyis brlabs par mdzod// yon bdag nad rnams zhi ba dang*// tshe dang dbang thang 'phel ba dang*// rigs rgyud dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// lo phyugs rtag tu legs par shog /tsha tsha brgya yi byin brlabs kyis// chos rnams shes shing byin brlabs ldan// dge bshes rnams dang 'phrad gyur nas// bstan pa snyan po 'dzin par shog /nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi nas kyang*// tshe srog mi 'gyur brtan par shog /mdo phran brgya yi byin brlabs kyis// rtag tu chos la dad pa dang*// 'gro la chos 'khor ston pa dang*// byams sems snying rje che ba dang*// chos nyid don rtogs grol bar shog

/mi mo brgya yi byin brlabs kyis// skye bo yongs kyi mi kha dang*// bud med yongs kyi 'phang kha dang*// ban bon yongs kyi sngags zor dang*// lha 'dre yongs kyi nad kha dang*// mi mthun yongs kyi ngan kha dang*// rmi lam yongs kyi gdangs kha dang*// ltas ngan yongs kyi sdig kha dang*// dgra bo yongs kyi dmag kha dang*// ngar blud 'di yis bzlog tu gsol// de nas snyan po btang ba ni/ hūṃ/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// me'i 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i tshe// chab gtor 'di yis phan yon gyis// me'i bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// chu yi 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i tshe// tsha tsha 'di yis byin brlabs kyis// shel gyi ri las thar bar shog /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// rlung gi 'jig pa 'byung ba'i tshe// mdo phran 'di yis byin brlabs kyis// rlung gi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// ltas ngan 'jigs pa byung ba'i tshe// ngar blud 'di yis byin brlabs kyis// bltas ngan rang la rang zhi shog /sa yis chu yi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// chu yis me yi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// me yis rlung gi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// rlung gis sa yi bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// ngar blud 'di yis bltas ngan bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// mdo yis 'dre'i bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// gsum pa blud rab btang ba ni/ hūṃ/ kyai/ dang po ngar blud ga nas byung*// ngar byung dang po 'bru las byung*// dang po 'bru rtsal ga nas rtsal// dang po nas 'bru cha gcig ni// bya rgyal khyung gi gre ba'i nang nas byung*// da rung nas 'bru cha gcig ni// sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan yul nas byung*// de nas nas 'bru cha gcig ni// lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyi// rin chen khang bzang nang nas byung*// de nas nas 'bru cha gcig ni// lha ma yin gyi yul nas byung*// sa bdag sgrom bu'i nang nas byung*// da rung nas 'bru cha gcig ni// zhi ba rgan rgon bang mdzod nang nas byung*// nas kyi pha ni gnam yang yin// nas kyi ma ni sa yang yin// 'bras bu lo thog dus su smin// nas dkar mo 'bru bdun gang skyes na// dpyid zla gsum la drod dang rlan gyis skyes// ston zla gsum la 'bras bu dus su smin// dgun zla gsum la 'phrul mo che'i phyag du 'bul// la la bdag gi skyems su bgyis// phud byung dang po de nas byung*// la la bdag gi bshos su bgyis// ngar blud dang po de nas byung*// rin chen ngar gyi mi chen 'di// rin chen lnga la rten bcas nas// rus pa'i de yang phrad du byas// 'bru sna lnga la rten bcas nas// lus sha'i de yang phrad du byas// mtsho mo gnyan la chu bcus nas// brag gi de yang phrad du byas// rin chen ngar gyi mi chen la// khong la de ni rus ma mchis// rus pa'i blud du rin chen sna lnga 'bul// kha na de ni so ma mchis// so yi blud du 'gron bu 'bul// dpral na de ni mig ma mchis// lung thang mig gi blud du 'bul// khong na de ni snying ma mchis// snying gi blud du zho sha 'bul// kha la bre'u khal ma'i blud du 'bul// rin chen sna lnga sha'i blud du 'bul// dbang po lag pa lag pa'i blud du 'bul// chu srin sder mo rkang pa'i blud du 'bul// lus la de ni rus ma mchis// dung chen dkar mo rus pa'i blud du 'bul// kha na de ni so ma mchis// 'gron bu so yi blud du 'bul// brag chag lha mo rna ba'i blud du 'bul// zang bu mchu ring sna yi blud du 'bul// sa dkar po lpags pa'i blud du 'bul// tshal chen lcog la khrag gi blud du 'bul// sku'i blud la 'phangs pa'i gos phud nas// rin chen ngar gyi mi la dkon// phug nas gces pa'i nor phyung nas// rin chen ngar gyi mi la rdzongs/

g.yas na sde ni gser yang bskur// yas kyi de ni bdud kyang mnyes// yab la bdud kyi spyan mnga' ru// ngar blud bro brdung khrabs se khrabs// ngar blud glu len kyu ru ru// lag pa g.yon du g.yu yang bskur// ma la'i bdud mo de yang mnyes// ma la'i bdud mo'i spyan mnga' ru// ngar blud bro brdung khrabs se khrabs// ngar blud glu len kyu ru ru// phrag pa g.yas su mda' yang btsugs// skyes pa pho yi blud du 'bul// ngar blud bro brdung khrabs se khrabs// ngar glud glu len kyu ru ru// ngar blud phrag pa g.yon pa ru// mo 'phangs bya rbal ma yang btsugs// za ma mo yi blud du 'bul// ngar blud bro brdung khrabs se khrabs// ngar blud glu len kyu ru ru// lus la mdzes pa'i dar rtags nas// byis pa chung gi blud du 'bul// ngar blud bro brdung khrabs se khrabs// ngar blud glu len kyu ru ru// mgo la nam mkha' 'ja' ris btsugs// yon bdag sems kyi blud du 'bul// de ltar bdag gis blud phul bas// lha srin sde brgyad spyan lam du// ngar blud bro brdung khrabs se khrabs// ngar blud glu len kyu ru ru// mi la ma gzigs blud la gzigs// blud rnams lha srin sde brgyad kyi// spyan lam du ni sha ra ra// bzhes don snying lnga'i blud du 'bul ba ni 'di skad do// lho phyogs me'i khams lags te// yon bdag snying yang me'i khams// snying gi dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// dbang thang me ltar 'bar bar mdzod// nub phyogs lcags kyi khams lags te// yon bdag blo ba lcags kyi khams// blo ba'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// tshe srog lcags las sra bar mdzod// byang phyogs chu'i khams lags ste// yon bdag mkhal ma chu'i khams// mkhal ma'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// dbang thang chu ltar grub par mdzod// shar phyogs shing gi khams lags ste// yon bdag mchin pa shing gi khams// mchin pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// rlung rta shing ltar rgyas par mdzod// mtshams bzhi sa'i khams lags ste// yon bdag 'tsher pa sa'i khams// 'tsher ma'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// dbang thang sa ltar snyom par mdzod//

lnga pa bla blu ba ni/ lag tu nas thogs la 'di skad do// yon bdag ming nas che ge mo gshin rje'i kha nas bla blus so// ma mo'i kha nas bla blus so// rgyal po'i kha nas bla blus so// gnod sbyin gyi kha nas bla blus so// btsan gyi kha nas྾/ sa bdag gi྾/ the brang gi kha nas྾/ srin po'i kha nas྾/ gza'i kha nas྾/ mi kha'i྾/ sa'i྾/ chu'i྾/ me'i྾/ rlung gi྾/ ltas ngan gyi kha nas bla blus so// don bcus rkyen bzlog pa yang lnga ste/ spyir bzlog pa dang*/ ma mo'i tshang brus bzlog pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ sngags kyi bzlog pa dang*/ gtor ma cha gsum btang ba'o// dang po spyir bzlog pa ni/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal phrag dog rnam pa lnga// dug lngas blang pa'i don rnams kun// brgya bzhi'i mchod pa 'dis 'bul gyi// gdon de dag thams cad bzlog tu gsol// hūṃ/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bka' 'khor na// yum chen rnam lnga 'khor dang bcas// sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams// 'byung ba lnga rlangs nad rnams kun// brgya bzhi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis// 'byung ba lnga'i gdon rnams thams cad bzlog tu gsol// hūṃ/ shar phyogs nas ni yul 'khor srung*// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar// sku la dung khrabs se sham gsol// phyag mtshan phyag na pi wang bsnams// 'khor du rgyal phran stong gis bskor// zhi ba'i 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// rgyal phran pho nyar ma 'gyed cig /rgong po bran du ma 'khol cig /mi la shi chad ma gtang cig /phyugs la rgod kha ma gtang cig /bsris la 'bri bzhog ma byed cig /yon bdag brgya bzhi 'di 'bul gyis// khang sgo 'di ru ma 'dug cig /lam srang 'di ru ma 'dug cig /bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo// bzlog go gnod pa'i bgegs la bzlog /oṃ pra ti ra ye swā hā/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bhyo bzlog bhyo sdab po// lho phyogs nas ni 'phags skyes po// sku mdog ser la 'od zer 'bar// bse khrab stag shams bse rmo gsol// phyag mtshan be con ral gri bsnams// 'khor du bdud po stong gis bskor// rgyas pa'i 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// bdud pho pho nyar ma 'gyed cig

/bdud phran bran du ma 'khol cig /mi la shi chad ma gtang cig /phyugs la rgod kha ma྾/ bsris la bri bzhog ma byed cig /yon bdag brgya bzhi 'di 'bul gyis// khang sgo 'di ru྾/ lam srang 'di ru ma྾/ bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo// bzlog go gnod pa'i bgegs la bzlog /oṃ bhe ru ta ka ye swā hā/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog bhyo// nub phyogs nas ni spyan mi bzang*// sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'bar// gnyan khrab sngon po sbrul sham gsol// phyag na sbrul zhags mchod rten bsnams// 'khor du sa bdag klu gnyan bskor// dbang gi 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// sa bdag pho nyar ma 'gyed cig /klu gnyan bran du ma 'khol cig /mi la shi chad ma gtang cig /phyugs la rgod kha྾/ bsris la 'bri bzhog ma byed cig /yon bdag brgya bzhi 'di 'bul gyis// khang sgo 'di ru ma 'dug྾/ lam srang 'di ru ma 'dug྾/ bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo/ bzlog go gnod pa'i bgegs la bzlog /oṃ bhe ru bhakṣa ye swā hā/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog bhyo/ byang phyogs nas ni rnam thos sras// sku mdog sngon po 'od zer 'bar// g.yu khrab bse sham 'bal mo gsol// phyag na rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams// 'khor du ma mo stong gis bskor// drag po'i 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// ma mo bran du ma 'khol cig /yul lha pho nyar ma 'gyed྾/ mi la shi chad ma gtang cig /phyugs la rgod kha ma྾/ bsris la 'bri bzhog ma byed cig /yon bdag brgya bzhi 'di 'bul gyis// khang sgo 'di ru ma 'dug྾/ lam bsrang 'di ru ma 'dug྾/ bhyo bhyo sdang ba'i dgra la bhyo// bzlog go gnod pa'i bgegs la bzlog /oṃ bhai shra ma na ye swā hā/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog bhyo/ hūṃ/ rgyal po chen mo sde bzhi la// yon bdag dad pas 'bul lags na// thugs rje dgongs la bzhes su gsol// pho 'dre yongs la bka' nan bsrungs// yas kyi bdud g.yos bzlog du gsol// mo 'dre yongs la bka' nan bsrungs// mas kyi sri blangs bzlog tu gsol//

bhyos gdabs so// hūṃ/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun nang shed na// ma mo dkar mo'i tshogs bcas rnams// sku la dar dkar la'u gsol// phyag na nad kyis rkyal pa bsnams// rgyu ni nyi ma'i zer la rgyu// sdong ni nyi ma shar la sdong*// las su byis pa'i srog rtsa gcod// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// bying byed mtsho'i nang bshed na// mtsho sman rgyal mo mched dgu yang*// sku la g.yu yi la'u gsol// phyag na nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams// chibs su chu glang sngon po chibs// sdong ni klu srin yongs dang sdong*// rgyu ni mun pa'i dmag la rgyu// las su mdze dang shu ba gtong*// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// khrag mtsho mer ba'i nang shed na// ma mo nag mo'i tshogs bcas ni// sku la zang nag la'u gsol// phyag na breg pa'i spu gri bsnams// chibs su dre'i rta rkang gsum chibs// rgyu ni nam gyi gung la rgyu// sdong ni bdud po bcu dang sdong*// las su skyes pa'i srog rtsa gcod// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// sha khrag dpung ba'i dur khrod nas// ma mo dmug mo'i tshogs bcas ni// sku la bcos dmar la'u gsol// phyag na sho rde'u dkar nag bsnams// rgyu ni srod dang tho rangs rgyu// sdong ni btsan po yongs dang sdong*// las su byis pa bud med bza'// khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// chos nas yas blud btang zhing sgo phye ba ni 'di skad do// kyai blud gtang dang po gang nas gtang*// nyi ma shar phyogs pha gi na// shar gyi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog dkar mo rta'i dbu// phyag na lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams// sgo ma'i rgyal mo sgo phye cig /'phrang ma'i rgyal mo 'phrang gsal cig /yas sgo de ni phye ru gsol// sgo drung de'i g.yas pa na// stag chen de ni sder mo can// mche rtseg de ni zangs se zangs// sgo drung de yi g.yon pa na// gzig chen de na thig le can// spyan mig de ni g.yon pa log

/khye sgo ba rnams la sgo btsas 'bul// 'phrang ma rnams la 'phrang btsas 'bul// ming po rdo rje blud gtong na// sring mo rdo rje blud long cig /blud 'di shar gyi phyogs su skyol// rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung*// dri za'i 'khor tshogs 'khor bcas la// mi'i tshe blud 'jal lo gsungs// phyugs kyi nor blud 'jal lo gsungs// lan chags stong 'phrin 'jal lo gsungs// phul ba'i blud 'di da lta bzhes// phul ba'i blud 'di ma bzhes na// phyis kyang blud 'dod ma gsung cig /de bas phul ba'i blud 'di bzhes// blud 'di slar la byams sa re// zor 'di slar la phros sa re// ming gi las bcol khyed kyis bsgrubs// blud kha nyi ma shar du sgyur// ces shar gyi blud gtong ngo*// de nas gser skyems gtang ba ni/ hūṃ/ shar gyi dkar mo las mkhan ma// rigs nas rigs kyi gtso mo mdzad// de ring khyed la brgya bzhi 'bul// de ring las rnams grub du gsol// mi mo 'di rnams blud du 'bul// shar gyi gdon rnams bzlog tu gsol// shar gyi gdon rnams ma bzlog na// dkar mo las mkhan ma lags so// zhal zas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gdon rnams da lta bzlog tu gsol// ces gser skyems gtang ngo*// de nas lho'i blud gtang ba ni/ da ni blud gtang gang du btang*// nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na// lho'i sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog nag mo phag gi dbu// phyag na zhags pa'i lde mig bsnams// sgo ma'i rgyal mo sgo phye cig /phrang ma'i rgyal mos 'phrang gsal cig /g.yas sgo de ni phye ru gsol// sgo drung de'i g.yas phyogs na// stag chen de ni sder mo can// mche rtsegs de ni zang se zang*// sgo drung de'i g.yon phyogs na// gzig chen de ni thig le can// spyan mig de ni g.yon pa log /khyed sgo ba rnams la sgo btsas 'bul// 'phrang ma rnams la 'phrang btsas 'bul// ming po rdo rje blud gtong na// sring mo rdo rje blud long cig

/blud 'di lho'i phyogs su skyol// rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po// grul bum gdon tshogs 'khor bcas la// mi yi tshe blud 'jal lo gsungs// phyugs kyi nor blud 'jal lo gsungs// lan chags stong 'phrin 'jal lo gsungs// phul ba'i blud 'di da lta bzhes// phul ba'i blud 'di ma bzhes na// phyis kyang blud 'dod ma gsung cig /de bas phul ba'i blud bzhes la// blud 'di slar la byams sa re// zor 'di slar la 'phros sa re// ming gi las bcol khyed kyis bsgrubs// blud kha nyi ma lhor sgyur ro// ces blud gtang ngo*// de nas gser skyems gtang ba ni/ lho'i sngon mo las mkhan ma// rin chen rigs kyi gtso mo mdzad// 'di ring khyed la brgya bzhi 'bul// 'di ring las rnams grub par mdzod// mi mo 'di rnams blud du 'bul// lho yi gdon rnams bzlog tu gsol// lho'i gdon rnams ma bzlog na// sngon mo las mkhan ma lags so// zhal zas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gdon rnams da lta bzlog tu gsol// gser skyems gtang*/ de nas nub kyi blud gtang ba ni/ da ni blud gtang gang du gtang*// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// nub kyi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog dmar mo seng ge'i dbu// phyag na lcags sgrog sde dmigs bsnams// sgo ba'i rgyal mo sgo phye cig /'phrang ma'i rgyal mos 'phrang gsal cig /yas sgo de ni phye ru gsol// sgo drung de'i g.yas phyogs na// stag chen de ni sder mo can// mche brtsigs de ni zangs se zang*// sgo drung de'i g.yon phyogs na// gzig chen de ni thig le can// spyan mig de ni g.yon pa bzlog /khyed sgo ba rnams la sgo btsas 'bul// 'phrang ma rnams la 'phrang btsas 'bul// ming po rdo rje blud 'bul na// sring mo rdo rje blud long cig /blud 'di nyi ma nub tu skyol// nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mig bzang*// klu dbang gdon tshogs 'khor bcas la// mi yi tshe blud 'jal lo gsungs// phyugs kyi nor blud 'jal lo gsungs// lan chags stong 'phrin 'jal lo gsungs// phul ba'i blud 'di da lta bzhes// phul ba'i blud 'di ma bzhes na// phyis kyang blud 'dod ma gsungs cig

/de bas phul ba'i blud bzhes la// blud 'di slar la 'byams sa re// zor 'di slar la 'phros sa re// ming gi las bcol khyed kyis bsgrub// blud kha nyi ma nub du sgyur// ces blud gtong*/ de nas gser skyems gtang ba ni/ nub kyi dmar mo las mkhan ma// padma rigs kyi gtso mo mdzad// 'di ring khyod la brgya bzhi 'bul// 'di ring las rnams grub tu gsol// mi mo de rnams blud du 'bul// nub kyi gdon rnams bzlog tu gsol// nub kyi gdon rnams ma bzlog na// dmar mo las mkhan ma lags so// zhal zas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gdon rnams da lta bzlog tu gsol// ces gser skyems gtang ngo*// da ni byang gi blud gtang ba ni/ da ni blud gtang gang du gtang*// nyi ma byang phyogs pha gi na// byang gi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog ljang khu spyang khu'i dbu// phyag na dril bu sde dmigs bsnams// sgo ba'i rgyal mo sgo phye cig /'phrang ma'i rgyal mo 'phrang sel cig /yas sgo thar sgo phye ru gsol// sgo drung de'i g.yas phyogs na// stag chen sde ni sder mo can// mche brtsigs de ni zangs se zangs// sgo drung de'i g.yon phyogs na// gzigs chen de ni thig le can// spyan dmigs de ni g.yon pa bzlog /khyed sgo ba rnams la sgo btsas 'bul// 'phrang ma rnams la 'phrang btsas 'bul// ming po rdo rje blud gtong na// sring mo rdo rje blud long cig /blud 'di byang gi phyogs su skyol// byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin gdon tshogs 'khor dang bcas// mi yi tshe blud 'jal lo gsungs// phyugs kyi nor blud 'jal lo gsungs// lan chags stong 'phrin 'jal lo gsung*// phul ba'i blud 'di da lta bzhes// phul ba'i blud 'di ma bzhes na// phyis kyang blud 'dod ma gsungs cig /de bas phul ba'i blud 'di long*// blud 'di slar la byams sa re// zor 'di slar la 'phros sa re// ming gi las bcol khyed kyis bsgrubs// blud kha nyi ma byang du gyur//

ces blud gtang ngo*// de nas gser skyems gtang ba ni/ byang gi ser mo las mkhan ma// las kyi rigs kyi gtso mo mdzad// 'di ring khyed la brgya bzhi 'bul// de ring las rnams grub par mdzod// mi mo 'di rnams blud du 'bul// byang gi gdon rnams bzlog tu gsol// byang gi gdon rnams ma bzlog na// ser mo las mkhan ma lags so// zhal zas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gdon rnams da lta bzlog tu gsol// gser skyems gtang ngo*// hūṃ/ ma mo chen mo khyed rnams kyis// ma mo yongs kyi dal kha bzlog /bdud po bcu'i khram kha bzlog /sde brgyad yongs kyi 'dre rnams྾/ yas kyi bdud g.yos slar la྾/ mas kyi sri langs slar la྾/ pha khu'i rgan sri slar la྾/ ma bu'i byur 'dre slar la྾/ byis pa'i chung sri slar la྾/ chos kyi chos zor slar la྾/ bon gyi bon zor slar la྾/ ma mo'i rbod stong slar྾/ phur pa'i dbal zor slar྾/ nyung dkar thun zor slar྾/ zhang zhung glang zor slar la྾/ bod kyi ngan sngags slar྾/ bram ze'i khrag zor slar྾/ rus kyi gshed bzhi slar྾/ lo skeg zla skeg slar྾/ zhag skeg za skeg slar྾/ rmi lam ngan pa slar྾/ mtshan ma ngan pa slar྾/ mi mthun phyogs rnams slar la bzlog bhyo/ hūṃ/ shar phyogs sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog dkar mo rta yi dbu// phyag na lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams// shar gyi dgra bgegs khug las shog /rgyu sbyor chags sgo bzlog las shog /lho yi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog nag mo phag gi dbu// phyag na rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnams// lho yi dgra bgegs chings las shog /rgyu sbyor chags sgo bzlog las shog /nub kyi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog dmar mo seng ge'i dbu// phyag na nyi zla'i lcags sgrog bsnams// rgyu sbyor chags sgo bzlog par shog /byang gi sgo ma chen mo ni// sku mdog ljang khu sbyang khu'i dbu// phyag na 'bebs pa'i dril bu bsnams// byang gi dgra bgegs rdul du rlog

/rgyu sbyor chags sgo bzlogs las shog /ma mo'i tshogs bcas thams cad la// phud kyi bdag mo phud long cig /yas kyis bdag mo yas long cig /thags kyi bdag mo thags long cig /blud kyi bdag mo blud long cig /rgyu sbyor shi kha 'di yis chod// rgyu sbyor nad kha di yis chod// rgyu sbyor rgod kha 'di yis chod// rgyu sbyor dal kha 'di yis chod// rgyu sbyor tshe srog 'di yis bslu// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*// dbang thang longs spyod rgyas pa dang*// bkra shis bsam pa 'grub par mdzod//

bye brag tu ma mo'i tshang 'bru la bzlog pa ni/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum dang*// rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams dang*/ las mkhan chen mo bzhi rnams dang*// sgo ma chen mo bzhi rnams la// brgya bzhi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis// rgyu sbyor tshe dang srog gi blud du bzhes// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /tshe dang srog ni sra bar mdzod// ma mo chen mo khyed rnams ni// khyed kyi lag pa g.yas pa na// bdud kyi khram so bam re yod// sang phod sdig sang su 'chi ba// rdo cig ma mos khrams la 'debs// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di// gal te khram la btab na yang*// 'di ring ma mo 'khor bcas kyis// khram kha phyis dang ma cig ma// dal kha bzlog dang ma cig ma// dal kha gzhan du gyur du gsol// khyed kyi lag pa g.yon pa na// btsan kyi sho dhe'u dkar nag 'grems// de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams// sho dhe'u dkar nag gzhan du spos// brgya bzhi 'di yis blud mdzod la// bya dmar kyus nas mdangs phyung cig /khyed kyi mchan khung g.yas pa na// bya dmar kyus kyi bam po bsnams// byad dmar kyus nas mdangs phyung cig /khyed kyi mchan khung g.yon pa na// nad kyis rkyal pa sngo dmar la// sbrul nag lnga brgya'i kha 'ching can// sprul pa mang po de nas 'gyed// sprul pa'i dmag dpung thams cad la// yon bdag blud du brgya bzhi 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi blud du 'bul// yon bdag tshe srog 'di yis blu// ma mo chen mo khyed rnams la// khrag dang chang gi mchod pa 'bul// yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la// ban bon rbod stong 'di yis bzlog /ma mo'i byad kha 'di yis bzlog /klu gnyan gtad khram 'di yis྾/ bltas ngan yul sdig྾/ dgra kha rkun kha 'di྾/ skye bo'i yal kha 'di྾/ mi'i shi 'phro ngan pa྾/ nad ngan rim ngan dar྾/ rgyal po'i gnod pa 'di྾/ bsren mi'i gnod pa྾/

gza'i gnod pa྾/ gza'i ngan rto ngan྾/ nyi ma ngan pa྾/ zla ba ngan pa 'di྾/ skar ma ngan pa྾/ ma nyes kha yog྾/ phyogs ngan bdud bcod྾/ lha srin sde brgyad྾/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi྾/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu྾/ rmi lam ngan pa 'di྾/ mtshan ma ngan pa྾/ nad kha chod las dal kha sgyur// dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du lhog /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar mdzod// gsum pa bltas ngan bzlog pa ni/ kyai/ sre mong kha nas byi ro khyer// nal bu g.yos pa'i ltas ngan yin// de yang srid pa'i brgya bzhis gyur// smon glang rol na 'khun pa sde// sa bdag klu gnyan g.yos pa'i ltas ngan yin// de yang srid pa'i brgya bzhis gyur// sbra nag dgur shing chag pa yang*// pho lha khros pa'i ltas ngan yin// de yang srid pa'i brgya bzhi྾/ mdung shing sked par chag pa yang*// sman mo khros pa'i ltas ngan yin/ de yang srid pa'i྾/ ri dwags grong bar bshags pa dang*// gong bsred khyim du 'ongs pa ni// yul lha khros pa'i྾/ de yang srid pa'i྾/ ma sring chung mar nal ba de// sman mo 'khros pa'i ltas྾/ de yang srid pa'i྾/ khang khyim me yis tshig pa dang*// zhing khang chu yis khyer ba ni// phung sri g.yos pa'i ltas ngan yin// de yang srid pa'i྾/ mag pa rgyug mo mdzom pa dang*// ma yar bu yar tshogs pa ni// smu bdud 'khros pa'i྾/ de yang srid pa'i྾/ sogs pa'i me mong sdol ba dang*// lus bshas bltas su ngan pa ni// rim nad yongs pa'i྾/ de yang྾/ srod la 'ug pa rgol ba dang*// srin bya thog khar 'khor ba ni// zor kha g.yos pa'i྾/ de yang྾/ pha ma gnyis ni mi legs pa// bu tsha bzhin legs byung ba ni// pha ma bral ba'i྾/ de yang྾/ pha ma gnyis ni legs pa la// bu tsha mi legs byung ba ni// da'u bor ba'i ltas ngan྾/ de yang྾/ sgo khyi ngu zug byed cing thang la 'khyams pa de// sri can g.yos pa'i྾/ de yang྾/ bya long khyim du 'ong ba de// khyim phung 'ong ba'i྾/

de yang྾/ nam phyed 'og rta 'tsher zhing ga bros byed// mtshon chas g.yos pa'i྾/ de yang྾/ zhing la bzhi ris rkug pa de// ma rgyud skye rgyud chad pa'i྾/ de yang྾/ mu ma'i zhing la byi tshang 'cha'// phung sri g.yos pa'i྾/ de yang srid pa'i brgya bzhis 'gyur// chad dgu lha dgu srid pa'i brgya bzhis 'gyur// 'jigs dgu grol dgu srid pa'i brgya bzhis gyur// ltas ngan gsum brgya drug cu srid pa'i brgya bzhis gyur// ltas ngan cho 'phrul brgya bzhis gyur// 'jigs sngags grol sngags brgya bzhis gyur// lha dgu ya bdud ltas ngan yin// de yang srid pa'i྾/ chad dgu ma bdud ltas ngan yin// de yang srid pa'i྾/ chad dgu lha dgu brgya bzhis 'gyur// ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig brgya bzhis 'gyur// ye brog gsum brgya drug cu brgya bzhis gyur// gdon rigs stong phrag brgya bcu brgya bzhis 'gyur// de yan mchod ma mo'i bshags pa yin no// bzhi pa brgya bzhis sngags kyis bzlog pa ni/ kyai/ mtho mtho rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' dma' rnams ni yar gson cig /bar na bzhugs pa rnams ni gnyan gson cig / 'khor lo lhor/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// gshin rje'i dmag dpung 'byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag blud du brgya bzhi 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi blud du 'bul// yon bdag nad kha 'di yis mchod// yon bdag rgod kha 'di yis mchod// yon bdag tshe srog 'di yis bslu// gshin rje'i dmag dpung 'di yis bzlog /oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ ya ma ra tsa a pa na ye swā hā/ de nas khrag zor bud med 'du sar/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// ma mo'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag blud du brgya bzhi 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi blud du 'bul// yon bdag nad kha 'di yis mchod// yon bdag rgod kha 'di yis// yon bdag tshe srog 'di yis// ma mo'i dmag dpung thams cad 'di yis bzlog

/oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ ma ma rag mo a pa na ye swā hā/ gser skyems lud pa'i phu ru/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// rgyal po'i 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag blud du brgya bzhi྾/ sku gsung thugs kyi྾/ yon bdag nad kha 'di yis྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ rgyal po'i dmag dpung thams cad 'di yis྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ a pa na rā dza a pa na ye swā hā/ rdo dril bu shar du/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ gnod sbyin dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku gsung thugs kyi྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ gnod sbyin dmag dpung thams cad྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ akṣa hri ba a pa na ye swā hā/ khram shing lung pa'i 'da' ru/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ bdud kyi dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku gsung thugs྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ bdud kyi dmag dpung thams cad྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ dha sha khri ba a pa na ye swā hā/ nub du rma bya/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ sa bdag dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku gsung thugs྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon dag rgod kha྾/ yon dag tshe srog྾/ sa bdag dmag dpung྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ na ga ra tsa a pa na ye swā hā/ nyi zla steng du/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ tshangs pa'i dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku gsung thugs྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ tshangs pa'i dmag dpung྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ phra ma ya a pa na ye swā hā/ 'ur rdo lho nub tu/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ srin po'i dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku gsung thugs྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ srin po'i dmag dpung྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ raksha a pa na ye swā hā/ mda' gzhu nub tu/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ gza'i dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/

sku gsung thugs྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ gza' yi dmag dpung྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ ra hu la a pa na ye swā hā/ cho long lam rgya gram du/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ the brang dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ the brang dmag dpung thams cad྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ skar ma li pa a pa na ye swā hā/ tshon cha dgra phyogs su/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ mi yi dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku gsung thugs྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ mi'i dmag dpung thams cad྾/ oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ dmag chen po a pa na ye swā hā/ chab gtor shar lhor/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ me yi dmag dpung྾/ yon bdag blud du྾/ sku gsung thugs྾/ yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ me yi 'jigs pa zhi bar mdzod// oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ a ga ne ye a pa na ye swā hā/ sa 'og tu/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ chu'i 'jigs pa྾/ tsha tsha brgya'i byin rlabs kyis// yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ chu'i bskal pa zhi bar mdzod// oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ pa ni ye a pa na ye swā hā/ me nub byang du/ yon bdag྾/ rlung gi 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i tshe// mdo phran 'di'i byin brlabs kyis// yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon dag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ rlung gi 'jigs pa zhi bar mdzod// oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ yaṃ yaṃ ni a pa na ye swā hā/ gtor mas phyogs bzhir bzlog pa ni/ yon bdag rgyu sbyor྾/ sa yi 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i tshe// ngar blud brgya yi byin rlabs kyis// yon bdag nad kha྾/ yon bdag rgod kha྾/ yon bdag tshe srog྾/ sa yi 'jigs pa zhi bar mdzod// oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ pu ti nan a pa na ye swā hā/ ltas ngan byung ba'i phyogs su thal ba gtor/ the legs gdabs la/

yon bdag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// ltas ngan 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i tshe// dkyil 'khor khra bo'i byin brlabs kyis// yon bdag nad kha 'di yi chod// yon bdag tshe srog 'di yi bslu// bltas ngan 'byung bar rang la sdig /ltas ngan 'jigs pa zhi bar mdzod// oṃ pa ra tsakra hri ti/ bltas ngan thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /yon bdag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// mi mthun phyogs kyi gang tshe ba// srid pa'i brgya bzhis zhi bar mdzod// bltas ngan thams cad rang dbang med par zhi bar 'gyur// rkyen ngan bar gcod zhi bar 'gyur/// / bzlog pa shes tshad bya'o// lnga pa gtor mas cha gsum btang ba ni/ rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bya'o// don bcu gcig pa dbang bskur ba la lnga ste/ tsha tsha la rten nas sku'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ mdo phran las brten nas gsung gi dbang bskur ba dang*/ mar me la brten nas thugs kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ chu gtor la brten nas yon tan 'phrin las rgyas par bskur ba dang*/ bum pa la brten nas rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ de la dang po tsha tsha la brten nas sku'i dbang bskur ba ni/ yon bdag rnams khrus byas la/ phyag 'tshal te/ dal gyi drung du bzhag la dbang bskur ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūṃ/ ces khrus bya'o// bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ hūṃ/ rin chen rnam lnga'i bum pa la// rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhugs nas kyang*// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sngags kyi sgo nas dbang bskur cig /sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs// oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri a/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ rigs lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur bas// las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa kun dag nas// byang chub sems kyis sems bla na med pa dang ldan par gyur cig

/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga bde gshegs kyis// dbu rgyan dbang bskur dam pa 'di// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// dbang mchog dam pa thob par shog /buddha a bhiṣiñtsa hūṃ/ ratna a bhi ṣeñtsa traṃ/ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hri/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ tsha tsha'i dbang ni/ tsha tsha 'di yis dbang bskur bas// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// sangs rgyas mang pos dbang bskur bas// sku'i dbang bskur 'di thob pas// lus kyi sgrib pa byang ba dang*// dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad bzlog /tshe ring nad med bde gyur nas// rdo rje lta bu'i sku thob shog /oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ka ni ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ ka ya badzra swa bhā wa ad ma ko3 haṃ/ mdo phran dbang*/ mdo phran 'di yis dbang bskur bas// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// sangs rgyas mang pos dbang bskur bas// gsung gi dbang bskur 'di thob pas// ngag gi sgrib pa byang ba dang*// chos rnams bka' dang bstan 'chos nyid// chos rnams spros bral thugs chud nas// skye 'gag med pa'i gsung thob shog /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dharma mu la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ wa ka badzra swa bha ad ma ko3 haṃ/ mar me'i dbang ni/ mar me 'di yis dbang bskur bas// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// sangs rgyas mang pos dbang bskur bas// thugs kyi dbang bskur 'di thob pas// yid kyi sgrib pa dag pa dang*// ma rig mun pa bsang nas ni// chos sku skye ba med pa las// rdo rje lta bu'i sku thob shog /oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta dzña na a ba lo ki te a bhi ṣeñtsa hūṃ/ tsitta ba badzra swa bha wa ad ma ko3 haṃ/ chab gtor 'di yis dbang bskur bas// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// sangs rgyas mang pos dbang bskur bas// yon tan 'phrin las dbang thob nas// yon tan mtha' dag rgyas pa dang*// mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spang ste// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa dang*// 'phrin las thams cad rgyas par shog

/oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta pa ṇi bha ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ sarba badzra swa bha wa a da ma ko3 haṃ/ sman sna lnga yi dbang thob pas/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi bar gyur cig /'bru sna lnga'i dbang thob pas/ mu ge'i bskal pa nas thar bar gyur cig /dri rnams pa lnga'i dbang thob pas/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa thob par gyur cig /dar zab sna lnga'i dbang bskur bas/ dar zab dang bskor chags 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig /rin po che yi dbang thob pas/ nor gyi rgyun la longs spyod par gyur cig /snying po lnga yi dbang bskur bas/ dbang po lnga tshang zhing dag par gyur cig /phye dang chu yi dbang bskur bas/ bkres pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal nas thar bar gyur cig / lag tu blud thog la/ na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dus 'di ring yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ nam la skar ma rtsis/ sa la nyi ma rtsis te/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis brgya bzhi'i cho ga gnyan po gzhung srang ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong la gtang rag gtang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre la gzhungs srang ste/ zang zing gis sbyin pa rgya chen po gtang nas/ lan chags dang snying rje'i mgron khyer/ 'gal rkyen thams cad ni bzlog /bar chod thams cad ni zhi bar byas te/ dus de ring nas bzung nas/ dka' ba mi la btsal/ sra ba brag la bskos/ theg pa khuur du khur/ byang chub don du gnyer/ mkhas pa'i lag gis bsags/ bden pa'i smre ngag gis bkrol/ brgya bzhi phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po bza' mi bran 'khol 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ lo rgyal po'i kha nas thar ro// zla ba blon po'i kha nas྾/ zhag dmag mi'i kha྾/ dus tshod mtshon cha'i kha྾/ bcu gnyis lo'i kha྾/ drug cu dbang thang kha྾/ mthun gsum rlung rta'i kha྾/ gshed bzhi rme ba'i kha྾/ par kha gdan sa'i kha྾/

gcig pa rang skyeg gis kha྾/ gnyis pa dgra'i kha྾/ gsum pa phung gyod kyis kha྾/ bzhi pa bzhi gshed kyis kha྾/ lnga pa mthun gsum gyis྾/ drug pa drug 'gram gyi྾/ bdun pa bdun zur gyis྾/ brgyad pa thang yag gis྾/ dgu pa dgu mig gi྾/ bcu pa dur sa'i kha྾/ bcu gcig sha lag gis྾/ bcu gnyis log 'dren gyi྾/ bcu gsum rnams rgyal gyi྾/ 'dre lnga bdud gcod kyi྾/ pha rlung ma rlungs ngan pa'i྾/ gshin rje'i dmag dpungs kyis྾/ ma mo'i rims nad kyi྾/ gnod sbyin dmag dpung gi྾/ rgyal po'i smyo 'bog gi྾/ sa bdag mdze nad kyi྾/ bdud kyi khram kha'i kha྾/ btsan gyi gdong kha྾/ tshangs pa'i kha྾/ the rang gi kha྾/ srin po'i kha྾/ gza'i kha྾/ mi kha'i kha྾/ mi yi kha྾/ sa'i kha྾/ chu'i 'jigs pa las thar ro// me'i 'jigs pa྾/ rlung gi 'jigs pa las྾/ ltas ngan thams cad kyi kha nas/ yam nad kyi kha྾/ rim nad kyi kha nas྾/ ngan rkyen thams cad kyi kha྾/ lo skyeg zla skyeg la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs thams cad las thar ro//

lag tu nas thog la 'di skad do// na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*// bka' bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ nyin zhag las zla bar tshe sring cig /zla ba las lo ru tshe sring*/ lo las gyang du tshe sring*/ byang las bskal pa'i bar du tshe sring cig /tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par gyur cig /lo brgya mtsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig /de ring brgya bzhi byas pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ tsha tsha btab pa'i yon tan gyis/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ sku'i byin rlabs dang ldan par gyur cig /chu gtor gtang ba'i yon tan gyi/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ thugs kyi byin rlabs dang ldan par gyur cig /mdo phran klog pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ ngag gis sgrib pa dag nas/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang ldan par gyur cig /ngar blud gtang ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi lan chags dang blud khyer nas/ dug gsum dag ste/ sku gsung thugs thob par gyur cig /gtor ma btang ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ mgron bzhi dgyes par gyur cig /mar me phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ sems can thams cad kyis ma rig pa'i mun pa bsang nas/ 'od gsal ba'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /brgya bzhi byas pa'i yon tan gyis/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gnyis/ tshe 'di yis lan chags dang bu lon thams cad ni khyer/ nad don thams cad ni zhi/ gnod pa dang bar chad thams cad ni sel/ tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod ni rgyas/ bsod nams dang tshogs ni rdzogs/ sku dang ye shes ni rtogs te/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub ni thob par gyur cig /ho brgya bzhi byas pa'i yon tan gyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang mjal bar shog /bkur sti rim 'gro byas pas/ tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag nas/ sems nyid skye ba med pa'i don rtogs te/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig

/brgya bzhi 'di yis byin rlabs kyis/ sdig pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig /dge ba thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /lha 'dre yi dwags thams cad kyi lan chags thams cad 'dis dag par gyur cig /yon bdag gi rgyud la nyon mongs pa dug gsum rgyas te/ ngan song gsum gyi rgyu bsags pa thams cad 'dis dag par gyur cig /bgegs rigs stong phrag rgya cu zhi bar gyur cig /ye 'brogs sum brgya drug cu zhi bar gyur cig /blo bur brgyad cu rtsa bzhi med par gyur cig mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig / de nas gtor ma cha gsum rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bya'o// de nas badzra muṃ zhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub rtsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol// maṇḍal hūṃ hūṃ muṃ/ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// bzhi pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo zhing*/ mi dmigs pas brgyas btab pa ni/ bsngo ba'i cho ga gang yang rung bas bsngo ba bya'o// de nas stong pa nyid zab mo'i don la bzhag go /don gnyis pa bkra shis gsol ba ni/ bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams stegs la/ nas 'thor zhing 'di skad do// hūṃ/ dbus kyi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// dbus kyi rnam par snang mdzad la// mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bkra shis yod// deng 'dir lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /hūṃ/ shar gyi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// shar gyis rdo rje sems dpa' la// sku tshad che ba'i bkra shis yod// deng 'dir sku lus bzang ba'i bkra shis shog /hūṃ/ lho yi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// lho yi rin chen 'byung gnas la// 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bkra shis yod// deng 'dir longs spyod che ba'i bkra shis shog

/hūṃ/ nub kyi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// nub kyi snang ba mtha' yas la// ba glang spyod kyi bkra shis yod// deng 'dir gzi brjid ldan pa'i bkra shis shog /hūṃ/ byang gi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// byang gi 'don yon grub pa la// tshe tshad ring ba'i bkra shis yod// deng 'dir bar chad med pa'i bkra shis shog /hūṃ/ 'og gi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// klu'i rgyal po bkra shis pa// yid bzhin nor bu'i bkra shis yod// deng 'dir phun gsum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /hūṃ/ steng gi phyogs nas bkra shis pa// dga' ldan lha'i bkra shis pa// gnas rab thob pa'i bkra shis yod// deng 'dir gnas rab thob pa'i bkra shis shog /hūṃ/ sangs rgyas yul du bkra shis pa// chos kyi dbyings kyis bkra shis pa// mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyis bkra shis yod// deng 'dir ci bsam 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /nyin yang bkra shis ya la la// mtshan yang bkra shis khyi li li// nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dza ya dza ya/ siddhi siddhi/ pha la pha la/ bkra shis par shog / brgya bzhi'i las byang*/ zhal khrid lag len cho ga rdzogs so// chos 'di rdo gdan gyi bka' gdan spre'u 'dra ba'i 'og nas/ paṇḍi ta tsan tra ghir tis bton/ lo tstsha ba bal po dza hūṃ gis sgyur ro// des 'phags pa shin kun gyi 'og tu sbas te/ phyis ayon gyi slob dpon padmas gter nas bton nas/ mnga' bdag rgyal po la gnang ngo*// mnga' bdag gis dbu rtse'i steng mkhar sa pa ṇi thugs khar sbas so// de myang shes rab grags pas/ 'di cho ga gzhung bzhin byas na/ 'bum tshar re dang mnyam mo// 'di 'gro don rgya chen po grub par shog /dge'o// legs so// bkra shis par shog // /
